message.content: Fix the orders endpoint N+1 query. The feed currently loads each author separately.

content.text: The handler queries an author inside the orders loop. Collecting unique author IDs lets us issue one batched lookup instead.

input.old_string: const authors = await Promise.all(orders.map(order => db.author.findUnique({ where: { id: order.authorId } })))
input.new_string:
const authorIds = [...new Set(orders.map(order => order.authorId))]
const authors = await db.author.findMany({ where: { id: { in: authorIds } } })
